statement: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga (a debilitated planet whose debility is cancelled by a well-placed dispositor, and which itself rules a kendra or trikona house) is traditionally read as carrying a rise from adversity or compromised beginnings into genuine strength and status — a planet's apparent weakness converting into one of its most powerful placements once the chart's structural support is accounted for.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
